name: Unilateral Cable Lat Pulldown
cue: Bicep drives to your ear, then exhale as you pull the elbow down toward your ribs. Inhale as the arm travels back overhead.

name: Unilateral Cable Lat Pulldown
cue: 1 second to pull the elbow down to 80-90 degrees at your ribs, 1 second squeeze, 3 seconds back overhead.

name: Unilateral Cable Lat Pulldown
cue: Don't let your shoulder take over the pull. Try to feel the lats working, not the shoulder.
